description: Whole Core 2 runs under a fixed policy: map travel, fights with their setups, victory spoils (cinders, XP, offers), level offers, shops, rests, events with quest gates, act changes and the finish with its class unlock.

input.policy: travel to next[(path length + seed) % count]; fights: reactions off, play the first affordable card in hand order at the first living enemy, End Turn; rewards: take offer 0; shops: buy offers in order while cinders last (at most 3); rests: Smith the first candidate, then Level Up the listed attribute while points wait; events: the first open, affordable choice whose effects can run in Core 2 (swapClass refuses there)
